mechanics.claim: Kennen's abilities apply a stack of Mark of the Storm to enemies hit, refreshing duration on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.
mechanics.quote: apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Mark of the Storm'' to enemies hit for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times

mechanics.claim: The third stack consumes all stacks to stun the target and restore energy; this is not itself damage but changes the damage fight by enabling free hits and letting the target take extra auto attacks.
mechanics.quote: The third stack against a target consumes them all to {{tip|stun}} them

mechanics.claim: Kennen restores energy even if the mark-triggered stun kills the target.
mechanics.quote: '''Kennen''' will still restore energy if the target dies from the third stack of ''Mark of the Storm''.

mechanics.claim: After Slicing Maelstrom applies its third stack, the target is immune to further Slicing Maelstrom stacks for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits.
mechanics.quote: After {{ai|Slicing Maelstrom|Kennen}} applies its third stack, the target gains a 6-second stack immunity against ''Slicing Maelstrom'' that refreshes on subsequent hits.

mechanics.claim: Mark of the Storm can be blocked by spell shields.
